# semlog

> A structured logging library for Python, built entirely on the standard library's `logging` module, aligned with the OpenTelemetry Logs Data Model and W3C Trace Context, with zero runtime dependencies.

The name is `semantic` plus `log`: semlog applies the field names of OpenTelemetry's Semantic Conventions to log records, so every field carries a stable meaning instead of free-form text.

A service that is already running adopts it in `hybrid` mode, without rewriting any existing log line, and `SEMLOG_MODE=off` returns that process to its previous behavior at its next start. `hybrid` leaves the root logger's level as it found it, so a process that never set one filters out every `INFO` record, including the `http.server.request` completion event.

Run `python -m semlog llm` (or call `semlog.llm()` from the installed package) for the agent guide matching your installed version.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what semlog is, its philosophy, installation, quick start, public API, every FastAPI (`add_middleware` and `ASGIMiddleware` wrapper) and Django (`DjangoMiddleware` in `settings.MIDDLEWARE`, or a `WSGIMiddleware`/`ASGIMiddleware` wrapper around `get_wsgi_application()`/`get_asgi_application()`) integration route, configuration, output example, and compatibility matrix.
- [STANDARDS](STANDARDS.md): the normative record contract, severity mapping, extension limits, pipeline guarantees, compatibility policy, and references.

## Agent guide

- [Agent guide](src/semlog/agent_guide.md): the single, self-sufficient English guide for coding agents writing call sites against semlog: public API with signatures (including `DjangoMiddleware`), call-site rules, level semantics, the output contract, configuration, every FastAPI (`add_middleware` and `ASGIMiddleware` wrapper) and Django (`settings.MIDDLEWARE` and WSGI/ASGI wrapper) integration route, and migration/review checklists. Also returned by `semlog.llm()` and `python -m semlog llm`.

## Schemas

- [Log record schema](schemas/log-record.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12 for every emitted log record.
- [Event catalog schema](schemas/event-catalog.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12 for the `configure(catalog=...)` document.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, test, lint, and build commands, tooling policy, and branch protection for coding agents contributing to semlog itself.
- [BENCHMARKS.md](BENCHMARKS.md): benchmark methodology, scenarios, and how to run the harness; results are not published yet.
- [README.es.md](README.es.md): the Spanish translation of the README.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability and how to verify a release's PEP 740 attestations.
- [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md): how versions are decided, what the pull request check enforces, and how a merge to `main` is tagged and published after approval.
